title: Your Personal Injury Cases: First Call to Settlement in 3 Languages

sections.label: 1 - AI RECEPTIONIST AND FRONT DESK
sections.note: Every call is answered 24/7 in English, Spanish or Haitian Creole, several at once. Haitian Creole voice gets tested on real-style calls with a Creole speaker you trust before any line goes live.

sections.label: 2 - CLIENT INTAKE AND NEW CASE ONBOARDING
sections.note: The intake runs by phone, website, text or email in the caller's language. Nothing becomes a case until your conflict check and an attorney have cleared it.

sections.label: 3 - MEDICAL RECORDS AND MEDICAL BILLING
sections.note: Records and bills are requested with your approved templates and authorizations, then chased until they arrive. Every visit, diagnosis and bill is logged with the page it came from.

sections.label: 4 - SETTLEMENT BROCHURE AND DEMAND PACKAGE
sections.note: The draft is built only from what is in the file, so nothing is invented. An attorney approves it before anything leaves the firm.

sections.label: 5 - CASE MANAGEMENT AND CLIENT COMMUNICATION
sections.note: Your parts 5 and 6: one case file in your case management system drives staff tasks and client updates. Staff verify every legally significant deadline.

nodes.label: 1 - AI Receptionist Answers Every Call 24/7 in English, Spanish or Haitian Creole
nodes.notes: The caller picks a language or it is detected, and several calls are handled at once.

nodes.label: 2 - Each Caller Routed to the Right Person, Consults Booked, Reminders by Text and Email
nodes.notes: Urgent or sensitive calls go straight through to a live staff member.

nodes.label: 3 - AI Intake in Their Language: Accident, Date, Place, Injuries, Treatment, Insurance
4 - Conflict Check, Attorney Review, Agreement Sent to Sign, Unfinished Intakes Chased
5 - Records and Bills Requested From Every Provider, Followed Up Until They Arrive
6 - Every Visit, Diagnosis and Bill Logged With the Page It Came From
nodes.notes: This is what makes the demand letter traceable later.

nodes.label: 7 - Gaps in Treatment or Missing Bills Flagged to the Case Manager
8 - Brochure and Demand Letter Drafted From Your Templates, Each Line Tied to a Record
nodes.notes: Each line points to the record page it came from, so nothing is made up.

nodes.label: 9 - Attorney Approves Before Anything Leaves the Firm?
9b - Not Yet: The Attorney's Edits Go Back Into the Draft
10 - Word and PDF Package With the Exhibit Index Built In
11 - Your Case System Updated Once, Stalled Cases Flagged on the Dashboard
nodes.notes: No one types the same information into two systems.

nodes.label: 12 - Client Updates in Their Language From Approved Wording, Legal Questions Go to Staff
